item.guildmark.chapmans_cart.hint: Set it down on the ground. Use an empty hand on its shafts to take them up, and again to let go.
item.guildmark.chapmans_cart.hint2: Sneak and hit it to take it apart.
ware.guildmark.chapmans_cart.line: Twenty-seven slots under a canvas, your pennant on the pole
ware.guildmark.chapmans_cart.tip: A hand-cart you pull yourself, brought round from the yard by the town's carter. It holds twenty-seven slots under a canvas cover, with a pennant in your colour on a short pole, and slows you by about a seventh while you hold its shafts. Use an empty hand on the shafts to take them up and again to let go; the Drover's Whistle calls it to you, or tells it to stay.
message.guildmark.trade.cart.not_yours_u: That cart belongs to somebody else.
message.guildmark.trade.cart.break_hint: Sneak and hit it to take it apart.
message.guildmark.trade.cart.no_room: There is no room to set a cart down there.
message.guildmark.trade.cart.blocked: Your cart cannot find a way to you, and waits where it is.
message.guildmark.trade.cart.caught.ston: The wheels caught on the stones, and the shafts slipped from your hands.
message.guildmark.trade.cart.caught.wate: The cart is in the water, and the shafts slipped from your hands.
message.guildmark.trade.cart.caught.step: The way is too steep for the cart, and the shafts slipped from your hands.
message.guildmark.trade.cart.whistle.sta: Your cart stays where it is.
